titulo: Kiyomori's Visit to Nunobiki Waterfall: The Ghost of Yoshihira Taking Revenge on Nanba
material: Triptych of woodblock-printed books (nishiki-e); ink and color on paper
descricao: Triptych of woodblock-printed books (nishiki-e) by Utagawa Yoshifusa, dated 1856, 2nd month, depicting Kiyomori's visit to Nunobiki Waterfall and the ghost of Yoshihira taking revenge on Nanba.
